start: Settings, Plates and bars, member who uses cable and machine exercises

steps.action: Look at the row 'Machine and cable steps'
user_sees: Value 'Automatic' and the line 'The app learns each machine's steps from the weights you log.'
must_not: An empty value

steps.action: Tap the row
user_sees: Sheet 'Machine and cable steps' with 'How much the weight goes up on your gym's machines and cables.'
Choices 'Automatic' (recommended), '2.5 kg', '5 kg'
Under them: 'The app then suggests only weights your machines and cables really have. Barbells and dumbbells keep their own steps.'
must_not: The footnote cut off

steps.action: Tap '5 kg'
user_sees: The sheet closes; the row reads '5 kg' and 'Your gym's machines and cables go up 5 kg at a time.'
must_not: The choice not kept after the app restarts

steps.action: Start a workout with Cable Row
user_sees: Suggested weights on the 5 kg grid, e.g. 35, 40, 45 kg
must_not: A suggestion such as 42.5 kg on a 5 kg grid

start: Settings, Plates and bars, choice '5 kg'

steps.action: Open the row and pick '2.5 kg'
user_sees: Row reads '2.5 kg'; machine suggestions now go up by 2.5 kg
must_not: Barbell or dumbbell suggestions changed by this choice

steps.action: Pick 'Automatic'
user_sees: Suggestions follow the weights logged on each machine, e.g. 35, 40, 45 kg when that is what was logged
must_not: The 2.5 kg grid still used

steps.action: Open the sheet and close it without choosing
user_sees: The row keeps its old value
must_not: The choice reset to Automatic

steps.action: With '5 kg' chosen, start a workout with Barbell Bench Press
user_sees: Bench suggestions follow the plates and bar, not the 5 kg grid
must_not: A barbell suggestion forced to the machine grid

start: Settings, choice '2.5 kg', a cable exercise with history

steps.action: Change to '5 kg', then back to 'Automatic', closing the app between
user_sees: Each choice is shown on the row after reopening and is used for the next suggestion
must_not: A suggestion from the earlier choice after the change

start: Member on a gym whose machines go up 5 kg, choice '5 kg'

steps.action: Do three machine exercises and read every suggested weight
user_sees: Only weights the machines really have, as the sheet promises
must_not: Any suggestion between the 5 kg steps
The choice shared with anyone; it stays a setting on the member's phone
